name: Nanakoi
source:
A love more ephemeral than those fireworks in the sky...
Gratitude that couldn't be expressed by words alone...

One day, he was saved on the verge of dying.
The person who saved him with magic, no matter how you look at it, is just a normal high school girl who happened to be passing by.
He remains skeptical, but then he finds out that the girl possesses a special power to fulfill little wishes. From that point on, he decides to spend time having fun together with the girl, away from his normal daily life.
But little did he know, at the moment that forbidden wish was granted, the gear of destiny has started to steer away from its usual track... silently...

[Edited from the [url=http://www12.plala.or.jp/zeek-heil/nana.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
一段比天上的烟花更加短暂的爱情……

一份无法仅凭言语表达的感激……

有一天，他在濒死之际获救。用魔法救了他的人，无论怎么看都只是一个恰好路过的普通女高中生。他仍将信将疑，却发现这个女孩拥有实现小小愿望的特殊力量。于是，他决定暂时远离平凡的日常，与女孩一起度过快乐时光。

然而他并不知道，在那个禁忌的愿望实现之时，命运的齿轮已经悄然偏离了原本的轨道……

[改编自[url=http://www12.plala.or.jp/zeek-heil/nana.htm]官方网站[/url]]
